assertions.description: A graph with a physics sensor, a declared control law and a force actuator runs end to end.
REVERSE DIRECTION: the barometer reading equals p0 + rho*g*keel-depth at both the peak and the trough of the run, and it actually moves.
FORWARD DIRECTION: the commanded PWM saturates while the hull is far from its setpoint, and in steady state equals the declared law evaluated on the MEASURED depth (max deviation < 0.02).
The loop closes: the hull settles at the declared setpoint to within 5%.
The commanded PWM becomes a force on the same body in the same run, equal to the declared transfer function applied to the measured signal.
